# SPEC_JSON_SHAPE

## Summary

The response contract for the spec stage, as one prose constant: the JSON shape the model must return (materials with PBR fields and procedural finishes, components with partRef/textureRef/repeat/attachTo/anchor/grounded), the dimension semantics of every primitive (interpolated from `PRIMITIVES` in `fields/sculpt-spec`), objectClass strategy, material families, the canonical world frame (-Z forward, +Y up, +X right), an orientation cheat sheet, and the universal modelling rules. Craft rules only some objects need live in `prompts/recipes` instead; invariants the repair passes enforce get one line each.

## Import

```ts
import { SPEC_JSON_SHAPE } from '../prompts/spec-shape';
```

## Usage

Interpolated into `SPEC_SYSTEM_PROMPT` in `prompts/spec.gts`, the invariant first block of the stage-2 system prompt built by `buildSpecSystemPrompt`; keeping it byte-identical across objects is what preserves the upstream prompt-cache hit.
